items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: That's Mantan; he was a chef.

ctx.x: I believe we talked about this picture in Jazz People where you identified all the musicians. But interestingly, in this book Jazz In The Movies, there is another picture, apparently taken at the same time with the same musicians, but it's a different shot... But the thing that makes it even more interesting than the one in Jazz People is the other people that show in the picture on the set. And you identified some of them that you remember. Mantan Moreland.
That's Mantan; he was a chef. And that's Clarence Landry; they called him Frenchy...
He was in Jump For Joy.
